summary.text: Steve Patten is the Republican candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 42C, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He described himself in a Ballotpedia survey as a small business owner, writer and longtime Carroll County resident.

paragraphs.text: Patten graduated from Islip High School, and his career experience includes working as a business owner and president, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has spent decades working with local businesses and community organizations in Carroll County.
Patten advanced from the June 23, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Corynne Courpas in the general election for an open seat.
He said he is running to advocate for fiscal responsibility, local autonomy, affordable energy policies and accountability in Annapolis.
He reported endorsements from Senator Chris West, Sheriff Jim DeWees, Carroll County State's Attorney Haven Shoemaker, the Maryland Farm Bureau and the Maryland Freedom Caucus, among others.
